description: This file contains unit tests for the LeavePeriodService class within the OrangeHRM HR management system. It tests multiple functionalities including fetching list of months, date ranges for months, retrieving current leave periods, and calculating maximum allowed leave period end dates. The class extends KernelTestCase indicating it is designed as a test suite to verify the behavior of leave period-related service logic within the project.

classes.name: LeavePeriodServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LeavePeriodService in the OrangeHRM system. Contains methods to verify fetching of month lists, date ranges, current leave period details, and max allowed leave period end date calculations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of LeavePeriodService before each test.

methods.name: testGetListOfMonths
methods.description: Tests that getListOfMonths returns all month names in order.

methods.name: testGetListOfDates
methods.description: Verifies getListOfDates returns correct day ranges for each month, including leap year considerations and invalid inputs.

methods.name: testGetLeavePeriodDao
methods.description: Checks that getLeavePeriodDao returns an instance of LeavePeriodDao.

methods.name: testGetCurrentLeavePeriodStartDateAndMonth
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the current leave period start date and month, including cache behavior and null handling.

methods.name: testGetCurrentLeavePeriodWhenNotDefined
methods.description: Verifies that getCurrentLeavePeriod returns null when leave period is not defined.

methods.name: testGetCurrentLeavePeriod
methods.description: Checks that getCurrentLeavePeriod retrieves a LeavePeriod object when leave period is defined.

methods.name: testGetNormalizedCurrentLeavePeriod
methods.description: Ensures that getNormalizedCurrentLeavePeriod returns a normalized array with startDate and endDate strings.

methods.name: testGetMaxAllowedLeavePeriodEndDateWhenLeavePeriodNotDefined
methods.description: Verifies that getMaxAllowedLeavePeriodEndDate returns null if leave period is not defined.

methods.name: testGetMaxAllowedLeavePeriodEndDate
methods.description: Parameterized test verifying max allowed leave period end date calculation based on different current dates and start days/months.
